title: chore(deps-dev): bump @testing-library/jest-dom from 6.9.1 to 7.0.0
body:

Release notes

Sourced from @​testing-library/jest-dom's releases.

v7.0.0

7.0.0 (2026-07-20)

Features

BREAKING CHANGES
